notes.title: Super Meat Boy 3D looks fast, tough and enraging in the new gameplay trailer
notes.notes:
The tough-as-nails platformer returns in three dimensions, Super Meat Boy 3D has a fresh gameplay trailer overview you can watch right now.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/super-meat-boy-3d-looks-fast-tough-and-enraging-in-the-new-gameplay-trailer/

notes.title: Let us know: Which character would you love to see in Super Meat Boy 3D?

notes.title: Super Meat Boy will be back in early 2026 — IN 3D!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652074/7e6f3b3926c602af27e8329c64b61b2ec5c0ab7d.jpg"][/img]

Meaty greetings, friends!

Yes, you've read that right! The most iconic chunk of meat in video game history will be back on a x-, y- and z-axis! Get ready to die in Super Meat Boy, just like in the good old days. Except this time, in 3D:

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/MtXRCarKd9A"][/dynamiclink]
[b]Super Meat Boy 3D[/b] is once again a brutal platformer that puts you in control of our beloved cube of meat on a mission to rescue his bandage girl from Dr. Fetus, an evil villain in a tuxedo jar — IN 3D! Wall-jump past buzz saws, crumbling caves, and flaming forests, die a million times along the way — IN (you guessed it) 3D! With classic old-school difficulty, twitchy reflexes, epic bosses, and loads of secrets. That’s Meat Boy like never before — IN (say it with me!) 3D!

Get your meaty butts ready for tough-as-nails precision platforming action with brutal but fair levels designed to break you in early 2026. There's a lot more to tell you about S[b]uper Meat Boy 3D[/b], and we'll do just that very soon!

Until then, friends!
Sluggerfly & Team Meat

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288210/Super_Meat_Boy_3D/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
